artifacts.name: environment_from_dotenv
artifacts.description: Read only launch_cwd/.env into a new mapping and overlay the supplied environment without mutating either input or os.environ.

artifacts.name: test_importing_api_and_server_never_calls_dotenv_loader
artifacts.description: A bounded isolated subprocess replaces dotenv.load_dotenv with a marker and observes no call while importing API and server modules.

artifacts.name: test_launch_dotenv_is_exact_and_operator_environment_wins
artifacts.description: Only launch_cwd/.env is read, parent files are ignored, None values are removed, and supplied environment values override dotenv.

artifacts.name: test_environment_merge_does_not_mutate_inputs_or_process
artifacts.description: The returned dict is independent while the supplied mapping and os.environ remain unchanged.

artifacts.name: test_server_composition_passes_one_resolved_mapping
artifacts.description: Server Settings and ElevenLabsAPI consume the same explicit mapping with no ambient os.environ coordination.
